items.title: T Mobile (TMUS) Joins Carrier Push For SIM Based Authentication To Curb AI Fraud
items.summary: Major US carriers, including T-Mobile US, have jointly enabled a new SIM-anchored cryptographic authentication technology aimed at reducing AI-driven digital fraud. The rollout shifts verification closer to the mobile network level and moves away from traditional SMS-based authentication methods. The initiative positions carriers as more active participants in digital identity security for both consumers and enterprises. T-Mobile US, NasdaqGS:TMUS, is taking part in this carrier-level...

items.title: AT&T (T) Teams Up With Verizon And T Mobile On Glide.id Security
items.summary: AT&T (NYSE:T), T-Mobile, and Verizon have jointly enabled Glide.id's cryptographic authentication technology at the carrier network level. The collaboration targets rising AI-driven fraud by shifting from SMS-based logins to SIM-anchored cryptographic authentication. This move is intended to support passwordless authentication across services that rely on mobile identity verification.
